title: Clipboard
description: Clipboard sync (capability clipboard). clip-push carries text or image one way (inline, max 5 MiB raw). Large images ride clip-image-manifest + N clip-image-chunk on the same /clip lane (1 MiB stride, max 25 MiB total, sha256-verified). Text is plain-text max 262144 chars (256KB). changed_at + changed_c form an HLC stamp (lexicographic compare; old peers compare changed_at only). content_hash is sha256 hex of canonical bytes for dedupe (old peers ignore). sensitive marks OS-flagged secrets: auto watchers skip unless clipboard_allow_sensitive, manual Send always bypasses. origin breaks echo loops.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.4.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

kind.description: Discriminator: text or image. Absent means text for backward compat.

text.description: Plain-text clipboard content (kind=text). Never logged verbatim.

mime.description: Image MIME, e.g. image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif, image/tiff, image/heic.

image_b64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (kind=image). Max 5 MiB raw.

changed_at.description: Unix seconds when the content was copied at the origin (HLC L; old peers order by this alone).

changed_c.description: HLC counter breaking same-second ties; lexicographic (changed_at, changed_c) wins. Absent means 0. Additive.

origin.description: Which side copied; receivers drop echoes of their own origin.

filename.description: Optional original basename (sanitized, no dirs) for UTI/extension preservation; absent peers synthesize clip-<ts>.<ext> from mime. Old peers ignore it.

content_hash.description: sha256 hex of canonical bytes (text utf8 or raw image) for dedupe. Absent means unknown. Additive; old peers ignore.

sensitive.description: OS-flagged secret (Android EXTRA_IS_SENSITIVE, macOS ConcealedType). Auto watchers skip unless opted in; manual Send bypasses. Absent means false.

session_id.description: Chunk session id grouping manifest + chunks of one large image. Manifest + chunk only.

total_raw.description: Total raw image bytes for a chunked transfer (manifest + chunk).

total_chunks.description: Chunk count for a session (manifest + chunk).

chunk_size.description: Raw stride per chunk (1048576). Manifest only.

offset.description: Byte offset of this chunk (chunk_index * chunk_size). Chunk only.

data_b64.description: Base64 slice of raw image bytes (max 1 MiB raw). Chunk only.
